definitions.gloss: labor and management; workers and employers
definitions.explanation: Workers (labor) and employers (management) considered together as the two parties in employment relations. Used mainly in discussion of negotiations, disputes, and agreements.

examples.japanese: {労使|ろうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: Labor and management reached an agreement.

examples.japanese: {労使|ろうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まっている→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧。
examples.english: The conflict between labor and management is deepening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賃上|ちんあ}げ→賃上げ：14256_chinage⟧をめぐって{労使|ろうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Negotiations between labor and management over a pay raise are ongoing.

notes:
From {労|ろう} (labor, ⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧) + {使|し} (employer, ⟦{使用者|しようしゃ}→使用者：29863_shiyousha⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {労使|ろうし}⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧: labor-management negotiations
- {労使|ろうし}⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧: labor-management consultation
- {労使|ろうし}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: labor relations
- {労使|ろうし}⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧: labor dispute
